item.title: The AI Toolkit for Research Institutions: Five Tools for 2026
item.description: The AI toolkit for research institutions in 2026 is not one tool — it is five, each doing a distinct job. NotebookLM synthesises your own documents. Claude handles writing and visual outputs. ChatGPT brings breadth and integration flexibility. Gemini runs autonomous web research and generates visuals from data. Napkin.ai turns paragraphs into diagrams. Used together, they cover the full knowledge work cycle from intake to output without requiring any coding background.
